content.introduction: Asian financial markets include major exchanges like Nikkei 225, Hang Seng, and S&P/ASX 200. The top 10 major stock exchanges in Asia by market capitalization are Shanghai, Tokyo, National Stock Exchange, Bombay, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Saudi, Taiwan, Tehran, and Korea exchanges. The Guide to the Markets – Asia reflects data as of June 2026.
